concerns.text: Performance requirement states “pipeline must complete within 6 hours on a standard CPU environment” but does not define the hardware profile (CPU model, core count, RAM) nor a reproducible measurement procedure, making the criterion unmeasurable.
Memory requirement says “Peak RAM usage must not exceed a moderate threshold” without specifying a concrete numeric limit or how the measurement should be taken, so it cannot be verified.

Privacy requirement “No PII should be logged or stored; transcripts must be anonymized” lacks a definition of what constitutes PII and does not describe an observable check (e.g., schema validation, regex audit), rendering it unverifiable.

The specification contains no Success Criteria (SC‑xxx) section. Without explicit, measurable SC IDs (e.g., SC‑001: “p50 end‑to‑end pipeline latency ≤ X seconds on hardware Y”), there is no way to assess whether the project meets its goals.

FR‑001 describes edge‑case handling (missing labels, insufficient length) but does not state the observable outcome (e.g., “records with missing labels are omitted from the output CSV”) – adding the expected output artifact state would make the requirement directly verifiable.
